quick question, how do wars work in this game? Like can you go to war with someone and how does that work and do you fight wars in your region or do different regions go to war? I'm new to this game so a quick explanation would be very appreciated, thanks.

[quote=united_hydronia;58402199]quick question, how do wars work in this game? Like can you go to war with someone and how does that work and do you fight wars in your region or do different regions go to war? I'm new to this game so a quick explanation would be very appreciated, thanks.[/quote]
So wars in the roleplay are done via RMB which is what we are on now, you basically write out a post declaring war, giving the reasoning for the war, and any other details, then you ping the person you want to go to war with, with the post, and they reply. Most good war posts are four or five paragraphs in length and are detailed. I'd advise as a new person that you avoid going to war as immediately declaring war on someone upon joining is considered highly annoying.
Lore and worldbuilding is better then wars ngl
